preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10.
The number of nodes n in each test case must be between 2 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must connect distinct nodes within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must indicate that the hidden nodes were guessed correctly.

postconditions.expression: len(hidden_nodes) == 2 and all(1 <= node <= n for node in hidden_nodes)
postconditions.description: The hidden nodes must be two distinct integers within the range of 1 to n.
